mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies at Verona City Hall and a waxing crescent moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. Expect an overnight low of 55 degrees with no rain in the forecast.
In city news, we are reviewing the recent police activity report covering October 5 through October 12, which highlights a variety of service calls including accident responses and warrant arrests.

There is a busy schedule ahead for Verona tomorrow, October 14. You can visit the Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, join a trivia night at either The Mill or The Bogey Factory, or enjoy pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee.
Looking at the police department report, on October 9, a two-vehicle crash occurred on USH 18/151 near mile marker 76, resulting in a citation for unsafe lane deviation.
Today's flavor was OREO Cookie Cheesecake. As the store is currently closed for the night, we look forward to tomorrow's flavor of the day, Dark Chocolate Decadence, with doors opening at 10:00 AM.
